flow: save_essay (auto-creates student row in isolated DB)
SpacyAnalyzer.analyze (active spacy-analyzer-v0.8.0; BasicAnalyzer fallback only if spaCy unavailable)
selected_priorities -> diagnosis (max 2, score >= 0.52, evidence verified, confidence rules)
Feedback page -> Revision page -> Practice page (read paths consume persisted records)
provider_transport: DeepSeekProvider (app/llm/deepseek.py) OpenAI-compatible chat completions, JSON response_format
fallback_activation_conditions: primary raises FeedbackValidationError after the correction attempt
primary raises ProviderOutputError after the correction attempt
primary raises any exception on the first request (no retry for request failures)
priority_producing_component: Primary LLM provider output parsed as StructuredFeedback.priority_feedback, constrained by system prompt feedback-prompt-v0.7.1; selection basis is the Diagnostic Gate (calibration selected_priorities) passed into the prompt payload

priority_confidence_support_requirements.confidence: signal confidence must not be low
priority_confidence_support_requirements.prompt_rule: zero or one priority_feedback item is valid; never padded to two

evidence_source_requirements.gate: EvidenceRelevanceValidator.assess_signal against analysis artifacts; evidence_quote_candidates carried on DiagnosisSignal
evidence_source_requirements.prompt: Every evidence_quote must be one contiguous character-for-character substring of submission.essay_text and relevant to the current diagnosis

priority_fields_consumed_by_revision_pag: submission bundle feedback.priority_feedback (presence gate for no-priority info box)
practice_targets matching source_submission_id (target_label as feedback focus)

practice_target_creation_paths.production_auto_creation: NOT FOUND - no UI page, service, or submission-path component calls create_practice_target; journey classifier treats feedback-without-target as legitimate derived state 'feedback_no_practice_target'

journey_state_contract.priority_without_target: feedback_no_practice_target (Home contract: next action is revise)

active_configuration.source: runtime GET /api/v1/admin/configurations; migration 12 seeds config-v0.9.0 active on fresh databases

development_database_rule: Not opened unless exact source/configuration inspection requires a non-content metadata value; any access read-only, fingerprinted before/after, no essay-text extraction.
